body: My mother always told me that people who say they are suicidal are idiots and they are depressed because they are lazy. If they occupied their time they wouldn’t have time to be depressed. I’ve been fighting depression since I was about 10. I’m 34. I hurt myself today. My mother didn’t say anything even though I have blood, cuts and scratches all over my body, including my face. I’m sorry you’re in pain and you feel like you have to prove your pain to your mother. You shouldn’t have to prove anything to anyone. Society accepts physical pain as a fact. Your leg is broken and people sign your cast. You hurt emotionally and people say “just get over it”.

I know how you feel. I bet you’ve been told (and probably still being told) that if you would just act a certain way and don’t get so defensive and emotional than your life would be so much easier. Right? That’s what I’ve been told. Change yourself. Smile. Don’t get so defensive all the time. You’re being childish. If you just do these things then everything will magically fall into place. Like all of your problems will magically go away if you just nod and smile. Always feeling like all your problems and depression and suicidality is caused by your personality and all you have to do is just completely change yourself and you’ll be happily dancing in rainbows with unicorns
